notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {1}.
The Fungus Beast dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
The Treasure enters the battlefield, triggering Teething Wurmlet.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Teething Wurmlet trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.
